title: PBE0 outer EXX loop diverges with exx_separate_loop=1 and default exx_mixing_beta=1.0
symptom: MnTe GW@PBE0 ran 12h46m: inner SCF converges to drho ~ 9e-9 but the outer energy difference stays ~ 206 eV with no trend; |m| collapses from ~8.9 to ~0.006 mu_B.
root_cause: Suspected: the outer density-matrix update is too aggressive (exx_mixing_beta=1.0 with a separated EXX loop); not a Coulomb-method issue (the run never reached it).
minimal_fix: Cancel the run; converge a symmetry-preserving PBE charge first, then restart PBE0 from PBE with a small EXX outer-loop mixing.
validation: A restart from the converged PBE density with reduced mixing should show a decreasing outer energy difference.
avoid: Letting a diverging PBE0 outer loop burn a large allocation, or judging the magnetic state from the collapsed run.

parameters.exx_mixing_beta: small outer-loop value; restart PBE0 from converged PBE
